title: The Goddess's Scheme
text: “Oink! Oinkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkk!”
No need for Ark to translate that! It’s just a pig having a hysterical fit and squealing. Amid the pig’s squeals, a loud rustling noise has started.
“It’s definitely black! I’ll have you all culled!”
It’s a shame these can’t be shipped to the Pig King of Faubrey! After all, the Pig King is already gone thanks to Takt.
“I wonder what’s going to pop out. This should be a show!”
“I’m staying here instead of just checking the answer for no reason, but this doesn’t look like it’s going to end well.”
So said Ho-kun, who was all fired up, and Ark, who looked somewhat exasperated.
“Taking him down in one go with a Brionac is also an option!”
“Oink.”
The pig laughed defiantly right there. No matter what you plot, it’s all meaningless in front of me.
“Gwaa!? Gwaaaah!? Gwaa!?”
And just then—of all things—Filolial-sama was dragged in and had a blade pressed against her throat.
“Oink-oink-oink.”
“Wow… that’s a pretty lazy move.”
“‘Oops, you Trash Spear Hero—I’m famous, so I know all about you. If you make a move, Filolial-sama’s head will roll. Is that okay with you?’ That’s what Motoyasu-kun is saying.”
This is… a hostage!?
“Grr… you piggggg! If you so much as lay a finger on Filolial-sama, I’ll never forgive youuuuu!”
“Huh? Does that actually work on Motoyasu-kun?”
Ho-kun is looking at me with a surprised expression.
“No, Motoyasu-kun can’t move. We’ve been living together lately, so you should know that.”
“I know, but still… Isn’t it kind of amazing that he can’t move even when a total stranger is taken hostage? I mean, it’s just a bird being held hostage, after all.”
“Well, since the Holy Weapon is designated for a Hero, they wouldn’t be chosen unless they had a strong sense of justice and that sort of thing, right?”

“Someone who’d kill both the hostage and the hostage-taker just because a child they’ve never even met is being used as a shield—that’s a problem.” Ark replied to Ho-kun, looking slightly exasperated.
“It’s definitely the perfect countermeasure against Motoyasu-kun. Those rotten guys sure are clever when it comes to stuff like this, aren’t they?”
“How lamentable. On the flip side, even though Motoyasu-kun is a bit odd, I can’t help but admire his thoroughness.”
What on earth are you so nonchalant about!? Ugh… this is a very troublesome situation.
“Oink, oink!”
Just as the pig squealed, its minions… shifted their gaze away from me and toward Ark and Ho-kun.
“Huh? Are they targeting us?”
“Since we neutralized Motoyasu, do they think we’re the next threat?”
“Oink, oink!”

The Pig is pointing even more directly at Ark. Instantly, Ark lightly scratched his cheek while furrowing his brow, dodged the arrow fired at him, and—without dodging the Magic… it just passed right through him!?
“They’re going to capture this cat-Beastman-like guy alive, aren’t they!”
“Let’s goooooo!”
The pig’s minions surged toward Ark, forming a formation and charging with spears and nets.
“Oink, oink!”
The pig then pointed at Ho-kun and seemed to order the Magic users in the rear to attack. I can hear the sound of Magic being chanted. The incantation for a disruption spell…
“Gua! Guaaaa!”

Just as I was about to open my mouth to chant the disruption spell—with a “squeak”—the blade pressed against Filolial-sama’s neck shifted, and blood began to seep out. Does that mean I’m not supposed to move!?
“The operation seems to be going smoothly.”

Just then, a group of them—based on my battle experience so far, I sensed they were reincarnates of the same ilk as Takt—strolled out from the back of the building with smug, triumphant grins. That’s unusual. There are quite a few of them.
“You! You’re a reincarnate, aren’t you!”
“Judging by how things are going, Motoyasu-kun figured it out too. Yeah, that soul of his is so rotten it’d make your nose twist.”
Ho-kun gave it his seal of approval! Though, just a hunch, but like Takt, they seem to have a high level.
“We won’t stand for being lumped in with those failed low-level scum. We are the strongest beings who surpass everything.”

There’s absolutely no difference. It’s the standard opening line. These days, our policy is to deal with reincarnated beings immediately upon sight—no questions asked. After all, they’re impossible to reason with. They’re all full of that “survival of the fittest” nonsense—claiming that if you’re strong, you can do whatever you want—yet the moment they lose, they whine and try to force their absurd arguments on us. The dead can’t speak back; the proper procedure is to finish them off and dispose of their souls as well. But right now, Filolial-sama’s life takes priority. How on earth are we going to get through this situation?
“What the hell are you dawdling for! Can’t you even catch a single cat?!”
“How pitiful.”
As the reincarnated one says this, he’s rallying his subordinates—who’ve formed a formation and are targeting Ark—with a rallying cry.
“Seriously, I heard this was an opponent serious enough to wake us up—the backup plan for times like this—and force us to take action… but they don’t seem like much of a threat.”
“That woman—according to the stories, she was defeated by the heroes of this world. Talk about a disgrace.”
“Well, all we have to do is take over from here. Heh heh heh…”

Are they talking about the Crimson Swine itself? As I tilted my head in confusion, the reincarnated ones looked at Ark and then shifted their gaze back to us. Then, as they slowly opened their hands, a void appeared in the empty space—
“…I, the very source of power, command you. Come out!”

With a loud *whoosh*, my spear and my Father’s shield… no, what appeared to be weapons known as “Holy Weapons” materialized. Its shape resembles a staff… but it differs from Trash’s staff in every way, from its form to its very nature. I get the vague feeling that this is a higher-tier weapon than Trash’s staff. Weapons also appeared for each of the reincarnated ones and settled into their hands.

“A Holy Weapon in the form of a staff unlike anything in this world, and other high-tier spirit artifacts as well… Judging by the spirits’ resistance, it seems they won’t acknowledge us as their rightful owners. And to think they forced their way into this world like this. It’s not for me to say, but this is truly an act that defies even the gods.”
Ho-kun says to the reincarnated ones with a sigh, “You’re totally freaked out, aren’t you?”

“Acknowledge us? What are you talking about? I’m forcing them to acknowledge us with my power and wielding that power. This is how you use a weapon. And… there really is a way for Holy Weapons to grant infinite power.”

The reincarnated person seems rather proud of himself. Hmm, I wonder what’s going on? I get the feeling he’s doing something else besides just wielding that weapon. I can sense through the spear that the spirits of the Holy Weapons and Vassal Weapons are suffering terribly.

“Hah… How lamentable. I’d heard stories about it, though. I see, I see. You… are a remnant of the ones who ravaged this world—a special individual who was given some sort of mission by those who claim to be gods, I suppose.”
“Hmph.”

Later, Ho-kun looked into it and told me that it seems this was one of the special minions that the Crimson Swine had prepared, waiting for the right opportunity. This reincarnated being is sealed inside a crystal so they can survive even if the world is destroyed, and apparently, under specific conditions, the seal breaks, allowing them to operate in the shadows or take action. It seems that was a contingency plan in case Ark arrived. Judging by their history, the Crimson Swine’s true form first lets them enjoy a second life in some world as they please, then brings the Holy Weapon under its control, grants them a new body in another world, and uses them as a pawn for when the time comes. It seems the Crimson Swine himself is considered one of the top-tier reincarnators among those he controls.
“You Spear Hero and you bird over there, stay put. Or I’ll kill you. Come on! Hurry up and catch that cat!”

Ark furrowed his brow and stared silently. There was something about that look… I can’t quite put my finger on it. It’s really bothering me. Why is that? Even the calm part of me found myself tilting my head in confusion.
“I’d heard stories about this, but… this is a bit… unforgivable, I suppose.”
Ark slowly closed his eyes… then snapped them open with a fierce glare, fixing his gaze on the reincarnated warriors.
